name: Safe Input Buffer
description: Open-source input buffer for rings/orbs and wave release, with an in-game toggle button. Practice-only by default.

practice-only.name: Practice / Testing Only
practice-only.description: Only buffer in Practice Mode or editor playtest, so normal runs and records stay unassisted.

click-ticks.name: Click Buffer (ticks)
click-ticks.description: How long an early click on a ring/orb is remembered. 240 ticks = 1 second.
